logline: An eight-year-old, fixated on the brand-new wall sweeper her grandmother bought for her aunt, mishears a goodbye and carries it across an asphalt road into a neighbour's house of mourning, a moment her family still laughs about.
audience: Ethiopian family members and neighbours who know the story, and young Ethiopians at home and in the diaspora who grew up close to a grandmother. They watch on a phone, vertically, on LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Telegram.
intent: Viewers laugh warmly at a child's innocent mistake, feel the grandmother's love and the neighbourly custom of comforting the bereaved, and end the film thinking of their own grandmother.
style_block: Warm hand-painted gouache illustration, soft visible brush texture, gentle paper grain, muted earthy palette of ochre, terracotta, cream white and eucalyptus green, soft natural light, every person is a Habesha Ethiopian with brown skin, simple uncluttered composition with the main subject centred in the frame, no text, no lettering, no watermark
setting: Set in a modest, modern Ethiopian city neighbourhood in the 2000s: simple one-storey houses of plastered concrete block painted faded blue, cream and ochre, corrugated-iron roofs, painted metal compound gates, eucalyptus trees, power poles, and grey asphalt roads with blue-and-white minibus taxis
interior_setting: Inside a modest Ethiopian family home in the 2000s: whitewashed plastered walls, a cement floor with a woven mat, a colourful woven mesob basket, low wooden stools, a small window letting in warm daylight, simple wooden furniture

lines: Narration: Gemini TTS · Images: FLUX.2 klein
A true family story, in memory of my grandmother

shots.beat: The new sweeper, bought for my aunt
shots.reason: Introduces all three people and the object the story turns on: the sweeper is new, it was bought for my aunt, and I cannot stop watching it.
shots.image_prompt: Inside the home, three people in one room: on the left, an elderly grandmother, {grandmother_home}, wearing {everyday_attire}, smiling proudly; in the middle, the aunt, {aunt}, stretching up to sweep the high corner of the whitewashed wall with {sweeper}; on the right, a small eight-year-old girl, {child}, watching the broom wide-eyed; warm morning light from the window
shots.motion_prompt: The aunt sweeps the broom slowly up the wall; the camera stays still.

narration.am: ስምንት ዓመቴ ነበር። አያቴ ለአክስቴ ረጅም የግድግዳ መጥረጊያ ገዛችላት።
narration.en: I was eight. Grandma had bought my aunt a long wall sweeper.

shots.beat: Fixation: whose sweeper will it be?
shots.reason: Makes the fixation feel real and plants the question that drives the story: whose sweeper is it going to be?
shots.image_prompt: Inside the home: close-up of {child} staring at the fluffy bristle head of {sweeper} leaning against the whitewashed wall, almost hypnotised, chin resting on her hands, eyes full of longing and curiosity, soft window light on her face
shots.motion_prompt: She blinks slowly, never looking away; the camera pushes in very slightly.

narration.am: ዓይኔን ከሱ ላይ መንቀል አልቻልኩም። «የማን ይሆን?» እያልኩ አስብ ነበር።
narration.en: I could not take my eyes off it. "Whose will it be?" I kept wondering.

shots.reason: Shows the fixation lasted overnight, so the mishearing that follows feels inevitable.
shots.image_prompt: Inside the home the next morning: {child} sitting on a low wooden stool, hugging her knees, gazing at {sweeper} leaning against the whitewashed wall in a beam of morning sunlight
shots.motion_prompt: She tilts her head, still gazing at the broom; dust motes drift in the sunbeam; fixed camera.

narration.en: The next morning, my eyes still never left the sweeper.

shots.beat: Grandma leaves to comfort the neighbours
shots.reason: The heritage heart of the film: the black mourning dress and veil, the custom of comforting grieving neighbours, and the goodbye the child is about to mishear.
shots.image_prompt: Inside the home at the open wooden front door: {grandmother}, wearing {mourning_attire}, half turned back toward the room with a gentle wave goodbye, bright daylight outside the door behind her
shots.motion_prompt: She waves once and turns toward the street; fixed camera.

narration.am: አራት ሰዓት ላይ አያቴ ጥቁር የሃዘን ልብስ ለብሳ ለቅሶ ልትደርስ ተነሳች። «መጣሁ ልጄ፣ ቶሎ እመለሳለሁ» ብላኝ ወጣች።
narration.en: At ten, dressed in black for mourning, Grandma set off to comfort grieving neighbours. "I'll be right back, my child," she said.

shots.reason: The comic premise: her head is so full of the sweeper that a goodbye sounds like an order to bring it.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of {child} standing beside {sweeper}, looking up at it with a serious, determined little face, as if she has just been given a very important job
shots.motion_prompt: The girl nods to herself and reaches for the handle; fixed camera.

narration.am: እኔ ግን «መጥረጊያውን ይዘሽ ተከተይኝ» ያለችኝ መሰለኝ።
narration.en: But I thought she said, "Bring the sweeper and follow me."

shots.reason: Shows the journey and why Grandma never noticed: the child is always a few steps behind.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a quiet sunlit neighbourhood street with corrugated-iron fences and eucalyptus trees; far ahead, {grandmother}, wearing {mourning_attire}, walking away; closer to the camera, {child} following her with {sweeper} resting on her shoulder, angled diagonally upward
shots.motion_prompt: The girl walks steadily forward, the broom bobbing on her shoulder; the camera tracks back slowly.

narration.am: መጥረጊያውን ትከሻዬ ላይ አድርጌ ተከተልኳት፤ ወደኋላ ስለቀረሁ አላየችኝም።
narration.en: So I put the sweeper on my shoulder and followed her. I was behind, so she never saw me.

shots.reason: The image the family still laughs about most: a small child and a giant broom crossing a real road.
shots.image_prompt: High-angle wide view of a grey asphalt road: {child} small in the middle of the crossing, carrying {sweeper} on her right shoulder, the very long broom clearly visible, its handle angled diagonally across the frame and its pale bristle head behind her, a few minibuses parked far down the road
shots.motion_prompt: The girl takes small careful steps across the road; the camera stays high and still.

narration.am: አስፋልቱንም ተሻገርኩ፤ መጥረጊያው ትከሻዬ ላይ እንዳለ።
narration.en: I even crossed the asphalt road, the sweeper still on my shoulder.

shots.reason: Sets the solemn room that makes the arrival so unexpected; the mourners stay anonymous and out of focus out of respect.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot inside a dim, quiet house of mourning: {grandmother}, wearing {mourning_attire}, sitting down on a low bench among women in white shawls seen softly from behind and out of focus, sombre and respectful, soft diffused light
shots.motion_prompt: She settles onto the bench and lowers her eyes; fixed camera.

narration.en: Grandma had only just sat down in the house of mourning…

shots.reason: The punchline image, held with the music silent so the audience has room to laugh.
shots.image_prompt: View from inside a dim room toward a bright open doorway: {child} standing in the doorway with {sweeper} resting on her right shoulder, the very long broom clearly visible, its handle angled diagonally across the bright doorway and its pale bristle head sticking out behind her
shots.motion_prompt: The girl stands still in the doorway; very slow push-in.

shots.reason: Her shock (መደንገጥ) is the turn from tension to release, and it names the danger she imagines: the road.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of {grandmother}, wearing {mourning_attire}, startled, rising quickly from a low bench, one hand on her chest, eyes wide with surprise, looking toward a bright doorway
shots.motion_prompt: She rises from the bench, hand on her chest; fixed camera.

narration.am: አያቴ ደንግጣ ፈጥና ወደኔ መጣች፤ መንገዱን እንዴት እንደተሻገርኩ ግራ ገባት።
narration.en: Startled, Grandma hurried to me, wondering how I had ever crossed that road.

shots.reason: The release: love and laughter, the feeling we want the audience to share.
shots.image_prompt: Close shot outside in warm light: {grandmother}, wearing {mourning_attire}, bending down beside {child}, laughing with her hand over her mouth, while the girl proudly holds {sweeper}, tender and warm
shots.motion_prompt: The grandmother laughs, her shoulders shaking gently; slow push-in.

narration.am: ከዚያ ሳቀች፤ አክስቴን ጠርታ እኔንም መጥረጊያዋንም ወደ ቤት አስመለሰችን።
narration.en: Then she laughed, and called my aunt to take me, and her sweeper, back home.

shots.reason: The motif returns as a tribute: Grandma is gone, but the sweeper and the laughter remain.
shots.image_prompt: {sweeper} leaning against the same whitewashed wall as at the start, now in warm late-afternoon golden light, the room quiet, a folded white netela shawl resting on a small wooden stool beside it
shots.motion_prompt: Golden light slowly fades; very slow pull-out.

narration.am: ውዷ አያቴ ዛሬ በሕይወት የለችም። ይህ ታሪክ ግን ቤተሰባችንንና ጎረቤቶቻችንን ያስቃል። አሁንም ያስቃል።
narration.en: My dear grandmother is no longer with us. But this story makes our family and our neighbours laugh. It still does.
